about_the_game:
“Don’t fall.” — The last words from the friend who pushed you.

Madfall is a physics-based, first-person multiplayer chaos game. Punch your friends, blast them off floating arenas, jetpack across lava, acid, and oceans, and crown yourself king — at least until someone knocks you off in the next round.

Start bare-handed. Weapons crash from the sky. Grab one. Fire it. Watch your friends go flying. You’ll laugh, you’ll scream — usually both.

🚀 What’s Inside?

⚔️ Physics-Based FPS Combat → Bullets and punches don’t just hurt — they launch you.
🌍 No Health Bars. Only Gravity. → Get shoved? Fall off? You’re out.
🚀 Jetpack Freedom → Soar through the chaos, then regret your choices.
🎲 Varied Handcrafted Arenas → Lava, acid, oceans, collapsing platforms — every round feels unique.
🎁 Mid-Fight Weapon Drops → Baseball bats, revolvers, and ridiculous tools drop right into the mayhem.
💬 Voice & Text Chat → Team up, trash talk, or both… just before you fall.
👑 The Crown Awaits → Win a round, wear the crown. Keep it… if you can.

This isn’t a tactical shooter.
This isn’t a co-op adventure.

🔥 This is Madfall — pure, unfiltered, multiplayer physics chaos.

🛒 Wishlist now and join the fall !!
